title: discern setup config document

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema; ignored by discern.

version.description: Document major version. Omit (assumed current) or use a matching major; this build understands version 2.

slug.description: Project slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.

brief.description: Free-text description of what the project is.

agents.description: Which agent integrations to enable: claude_code -> CLAUDE.md, gemini -> GEMINI.md, codex / cursor / copilot -> AGENTS.md.

description.description: Preset metadata, shown when listing presets; ignored by `setup --config`.

map.description: [map] settings — chiefly the project-relative directory holding discern's agent documentation tree.

dir.description: Where the project map — discern's agent-maintained documentation tree — lives, relative to the project root. discern removes leading `./` prefixes and keeps one trailing slash. `discern setup` scaffolds it here, and `discern map` browses it by default.

jobs.description: [jobs] fills. Known names take a command, list, or { run, timeout } and derive their stage; a custom [jobs.<name>] table requires `stage` and `run`.

format.description: fix stage — a formatter/codemod (mutating; runs first, serially).

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

build.description: build stage — produce artifacts later stages read (compile, bundle).

smoke.description: test stage — the project's fast, side-effect-light readiness check: prove the app boots with real config and any essential shared runtime dependency in THIS checkout (a framework's about, a CLI --version, a config-load-and-exit). Both discern done and discern test include it in the fail-fast test group, so a quick failure cancels slower siblings. Not an e2e suite or a duplicate of Discern's built-in write probes.

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

stage.description: When the custom job runs in the gate (fix|build|check|test).

provides.description: Optional free-text label, for humans / audit.

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

additionalProperties.description: A custom job. Its name is open, but its stage and command are explicit.

scopes.description: [scopes.<name>] tables — a named region defined by `paths`, with optional attributes.

paths.description: The globs that define the scope: a directory prefix (src/**), a standard glob (src/**/*.ext, src/*), a *.ext suffix at any depth, a /seg/ segment, or an exact path.

neutral.description: true: changes here need no gate (docs, agent guidance).

previewable.description: true: a person could see changes here — worth a preview link.

gate.description: A command discern done runs when this scope changed (a sub-component with its own self-contained gate).

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

generated.description: [generated.<name>] tables — committed artifacts, their deterministic regeneration command, and an optional timeout.

paths.description: The scope-paths globs naming the committed artifacts this generator wholly owns: a directory prefix (`reference/**`), a standard glob (`reference/**/*.md`, `reference/*`), a `*.ext` suffix at any depth, a `/seg/` segment, or an exact path.

run.description: The deterministic command(s) that rewrite this group's artifacts: the same tree must produce the same bytes, and the generator must remove orphaned artifacts it no longer emits.

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

standards.description: [standards.<name>] tables. Coverage is just a conventional name.

metric.description: Metric name the run emits (default: the standard name).

direction.description: Required. "up": limit is a floor; "down": limit is a ceiling.

run.description: The command whose output emits the metric line: DISCERN_METRIC <metric> <number>.

per.description: Divide the metric to hold a *rate*, not a raw count — so the number doesn't rise solely because the project grew. Either a second metric the run emits, or a built-in extent discern measures itself: per = { words = "${map.dir}**" } (files | lines | words | bytes over a git pathspec).

scale.description: Multiply the rate by this so the limit reads in human units, e.g. scale = 1000 for "per 1,000 words".

margin.description: Headroom `discern standards --pin` leaves when it tightens this limit to the measured value: pin sets a floor to measured−margin (up) or a ceiling to measured+margin (down), and leaves a standard un-pinned when the improvement is smaller than its margin. Must be ≥ 0. Default 0 pins to the measured value; give a metric that drifts on unrelated changes (bundle size, coverage) a margin so a pinned limit isn't tripped by ordinary fluctuation.

measure.description: "gate" (the default): the measurement runs inside every `discern done`, in parallel with the tests. "on-demand": the gate skips only the measurement (for a metric too slow for every gate run — a full coverage run, a release build); the never-loosen limit check still runs on every gate, and `discern standards` measures it when you ask. Before deferring, prefer the smaller reliefs: declare `inputs` so unchanged trees replay at no cost, or raise this one job's `timeout`.

inputs.description: The paths this metric reads (scope-paths globs). When a gate run finds every change since the last recorded measurement outside these globs, it replays that recorded value instead of re-measuring — loudly, naming the source commit. Omit to measure every time (the conservative default). Risk: a too-narrow inputs list delays detection until the next measured run.

timeout.description: Per-job time budget in seconds, replacing the global [gate].timeout for this job only (0 disables the bound for it). Omit to inherit the global budget.

description: The declarative config shape consumed by `discern setup --config <file>` and by a preset's `preset.json`. Its jobs/scopes/generated/standards records are written into a project's discern.toml via the comment-preserving editor. Every field is optional.
